positions.title: Cap on liability
positions.standard: Each party's total liability under the agreement shall not exceed USD 250,000.

fallbacks.text: Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim.

positions.title: Excluded losses
positions.standard: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss or loss of profit.

positions.title: Payment terms
positions.standard: Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.

fallbacks.text: Invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

positions.title: Termination for convenience
positions.standard: Either party may terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' written notice.

positions.title: Governing law
positions.standard: The agreement is governed by the laws of Sweden.

fallbacks.text: The agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

positions.title: Confidentiality
positions.standard: Each party keeps the other's confidential information confidential for three (3) years after termination.

contracts.text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT (fictional)

7. Liability
7.1 The total liability of each party under this Agreement shall not exceed USD 250,000.
7.2 Neither party shall be liable for any indirect or consequential loss, or for any loss of profit.

9. Fees
9.1 The Customer shall pay each invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

12. Term and termination
12.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving ninety (90) days' written notice.

15. Law
15.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of Sweden.

SERVICES AGREEMENT — CUSTOMER FORM (fictional)

5. Payment
5.1 Payment of undisputed invoices is due ninety (90) days after the end of the month in which the invoice is received.

8. Limitation of liability
8.1 The Supplier's liability under this Agreement is unlimited.

10. Confidentiality
10.1 Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information confidential during the term and for three (3) years after termination.

11. Termination
11.1 The Customer may terminate this Agreement at any time on thirty (30) days' written notice.

14. Governing law
14.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

SUPPLY AGREEMENT (fictional)

10. Liability
10.1 Each party's total liability shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 and the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

11. Payment
11.1 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.

18. Governing law
18.1 This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
